svg.title: Мобилизация плеч с палкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Shoulder mobility with one straight wooden dowel held wide with both hands and elbows straight. LEFT standing upright, dowel in front at upper thighs. RIGHT dowel lifted high overhead, elbows still straight, same grip width and stable torso. Complete dowel end-to-end in each frame. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
